hero.title: Hair Transplantation
hero.description: FUE and DHI hair transplants in experienced Istanbul clinics. A natural hairline, no linear scar, and transplanted hair that keeps growing for life.

why.title: Why get a hair transplant in Turkey?
why.subtitle: More experience and lower prices than anywhere else in Europe

leaders.title: Most experience worldwide
leaders.desc: Turkey performs over 1.5 million hair transplants a year – more than any other country

guarantee.title: A result for life
guarantee.desc: Hair from the donor area at the back of the head is resistant to hair loss, so it keeps growing after the transplant

technology.title: Modern techniques
technology.desc: Sapphire FUE and DHI allow dense placement and a natural-looking result

specialists.title: Experienced Specialists
specialists.desc: The teams perform 50–100 transplants a month

precision.title: Natural hairline
precision.desc: Each graft is placed at the right angle, direction and depth so the hairline looks natural

survival.title: High Survival Rate
survival.desc: Up to 95-98% of transplanted follicles take root because they spend very little time outside the body

methods.title: Hair Transplantation Methods
methods.subtitle: The doctor recommends a method after looking at your photos

fue.title: FUE (Follicular Unit Extraction)
fue.desc: The classic method: follicles are removed one by one, leaving only tiny scars

sapphire.title: FUE Sapphire
sapphire.desc: Channels are opened with sapphire blades instead of steel: more precise, and the skin heals faster

dhi.title: DHI (Direct Hair Implantation)
dhi.desc: Grafts are implanted directly with a Choi pen, without opening channels first

dhiPrp.title: DHI + PRP Therapy
dhiPrp.desc: DHI plus PRP (platelet-rich plasma), which helps the grafts take and grow

beard.title: Beard Transplant
beard.desc: For a fuller beard and moustache, including patchy areas

afro.title: Afro Transplantation
afro.desc: A special technique for curly and tightly coiled hair

benefits.description: One price covers the operation, the hotel, transfers and aftercare.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.contactText: For questions about the processing of your personal data, contact us:

overview.title: 1. Privacy at a Glance
overview.text: The following information provides a simple overview of what happens to your personal data when you visit this website. Personal data is any data that can be used to personally identify you.

responsible.title: 2. Responsible Party
responsible.text:
The responsible party for data processing on this website is:

MedConsult Turkey
Germany

collection.title: 3. Data Collection on This Website
collection.text: Data processing on this website is carried out by the website operator. Your data is collected, firstly, when you provide it to us (e.g., via the contact form). Other data is automatically collected by our IT systems when you visit the website. This is primarily technical data (e.g., internet browser, operating system, or time of page access).

contactForm.title: 4. Contact Form
contactForm.text: When you send us inquiries via the contact form, your details (name, email, phone, desired service, message) are stored for the purpose of processing your request and in case of follow-up questions. We do not share this data without your consent. Processing is based on Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR (pre-contractual measures) or Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR (consent).

cookies.title: 5. Cookies
cookies.text: This website uses cookies — small text files stored on your device. Some cookies are technically necessary (e.g., language settings), while others are used to analyze user behavior. You can configure your browser to notify you about cookies and allow them only on a case-by-case basis.

analytics.title: 6. Analytics Tools
analytics.text: This website may use analytics tools for statistical evaluation of visitor traffic. The data obtained is not used to personally identify visitors and is not combined with personal data.

thirdParty.title: 7. Third-Party Services
thirdParty.text: This website integrates external services, including Cloudinary (for videos and images), WhatsApp Business (for communication), and potentially other services. The integration of these services may result in data being transferred to the respective providers. For detailed information, please refer to the privacy policies of the respective providers.

rights.title: 8. Your Rights
rights.text: You have the right at any time to obtain information about your personal data stored with us, its origin, recipients, and the purpose of data processing. You also have the right to correction, blocking, or deletion of this data. For these and other questions about data protection, you can contact us at any time. You also have the right to file a complaint with the competent supervisory authority.

storage.title: 9. Storage Duration
storage.text: Personal data submitted to us via the contact form or email is stored only as long as necessary for processing your request or as required by legal retention obligations.

changes.title: 10. Changes to This Policy
changes.text: We reserve the right to update this privacy policy to ensure it complies with current legal requirements or to reflect changes in our services. The updated privacy policy will apply to your subsequent visits.
